faq.title: FAQ
faq.content:
How does it work?

Open the blanket page, upload a photo of your pet, pick a style and add a name. You see your design right away. After you order, we polish the artwork and email you a proof within 24 hours. Nothing is made until you approve it.

Can I put more than one pet on a blanket?

Yes, up to 4. One or two pets are included in the price. For 3 or 4 pets we add a $10 collage upgrade at checkout.

Can I add names or a message?

Yes. Add up to 3 lines of text, in 4 lettering styles. You can move, resize, rotate and curve each line in the designer.

What photo works best?

A bright, in-focus photo of your pet at eye level, without filters. Phone photos are perfect. We cut your pet out of the background automatically.

Will the blanket look exactly like the screen?

Close, but woven, not printed. The picture is made of cotton threads, so colors come out a little softer and tiny details are simplified. That's why we polish every design and send you a proof first.

Where do you ship, and how long does it take?

We ship free to the United States. Production takes 1–3 business days after you approve the proof, then delivery takes 2–5 business days. You get tracking by email.

Will it arrive before Christmas?

Order by December 10 and approve your proof within 24 hours.

Is the art made with AI?

The pet cut-out is made automatically in your browser, and our team checks and polishes every design by hand before it's made.

Can I return my order?

Every item is personalized, so we can't take change-of-mind returns. If anything arrives damaged, misprinted or different from the approved design, email us within 30 days with a photo and we'll send a free replacement or a full refund. You won't need to send it back.

What payment methods do you accept?

Major credit and debit cards and PayPal.

How do I contact you?

Email hello@woventails.com or use our contact form. We reply within one business day.

Forgot to add a photo? Reply to your order confirmation email with it attached.

send-your-photo.title: Send your pet's photo
send-your-photo.content:
Ordered without a photo, or want to send a better one?

  1. Reply to your order confirmation email, or email hello@woventails.com with your order number (for example #1001).
  2. Attach 1–3 clear photos of your pet.
  3. For a storybook, also tell us your pet's name, up to 3 family names and their favorite treat.

What makes a great photo

  • Bright, natural light (near a window is perfect)
  • Taken at your pet's eye level, face in focus
  • No filters, sunglasses or costumes covering the face
  • Send the original photo, not a screenshot

Within 24 hours we email you the artwork to approve. Nothing is made until you say yes.

about.title: About us
about.content:
Hi, we're Woven Tails.

We started Woven Tails because the best photos of our pets lived on our phones, not in our homes. So we built a simple way to change that: send us a photo, and we turn your dog or cat into an illustration, then weave it into a soft 100% cotton blanket or make it the star of its own storybook.

Every piece is made to order in the USA by our print partner. You see and approve the artwork before anything is made. And if anything isn't right, we'll make it right with a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Email hello@woventails.com. A real person answers.
